posts.zh:
dsh-plugin-session-delete 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。在 Web UI 与桌面客户端中删除 DSH 会话：头部危险按钮 + 会话行菜单项，风险确认弹窗，宿主端点与 agent 工具同步清理会话日志、投影缓存与工作区记账。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-47528b7087f2ce0715ca.html
posts.en:
dsh-plugin-session-delete is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Delete DSH sessions from the web UI and desktop client: header danger button and session-row menu item with a risk-consent dialog; host endpoint and agent tool remove the session log, projection cache, and workspace accounting.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-47528b7087f2ce0715ca.html
